Frequently asked questions

Quick answers about where we work, what we do and how to get hold of us.

Where are you based?

In Stafford, Staffordshire.

What areas do you cover?

Stafford and across Staffordshire. If you are not sure whether we reach your town, send your postcode on the contact page or WhatsApp and ask.

What bathroom work do you do?

Complete bathroom refits, shower enclosures, baths and shower screens, wall and floor tiling, waterproof wall panels, and toilets, basins and vanity units. Each one has its own page under services.

Are you insured?

Yes. We hold public liability insurance with cover up to £1,000,000.

How long have you been fitting bathrooms?

15 years.

How many people are in your team?

Four.

Do you do shower enclosures as well as full refits?

Yes - see our shower enclosures page.

Do you fit waterproof wall panels as well as tiles?

Yes. Marble-effect panel systems as well as tiling - see wall panels and tiling.

Does a refit include taking the old bathroom out?

Yes. The old suite and tiling are stripped out and the waste is taken away as part of a complete refit.

How do I get a quote?

Call 07378 681330, send a WhatsApp, or fill in the form on the contact page.

What should I tell you when I get in touch?

The rough size of the room, what you would like changed, and any timescale. A couple of photos of the room as it is now help too.

What happens after I get in touch?

We will ask a few questions about the room and what you are after, then arrange to see it or go through your photos, and give you a straight answer on what is possible.

Question not here

Call or WhatsApp and ask us directly.
